"""
-------------------------------------------
|                                         |
|                                         |
|                                         |
|                                         |
|                                        <|
|                   <---               <><|
|                                        <|
||                                        |
|||                                       |
||||                                      |
|||                                       |
||                                        |
|                                         |
-------------------------------------------
"""
# light
distant_light(direction=vector(60, 60, 44), color=color.white)

# map
map_height = 5
# bow y boundary
move_height = map_height - 0.5
# target y boundary
move_target_height = map_height - 1.2


# Draw Map
top_box = box(pos=vector(0,-map_height,0), length=12, height=0.2, width=3, color=vector(1, 0.5, 1))
bottom_box = box(pos=vector(0,map_height,0), length=12,height=0.2, width=3, color=vector(1, 0.4, 1))


# Draw bow
bow_pos = vector(6,0.2,0)
bow_len = 0.5
arrow_start_pos = vec(bow_pos.x-bow_len*0.5, bow_pos.y, 0)

bow = box(pos=bow_pos, length=bow_len, height=bow_len, width=bow_len)
bow_arrow = arrow(pos=arrow_start_pos, axis=vector(-1,0,0), shaftwidth=0.1)

# delta t accumulate
acc_bow_t = 0
acc_target_t = 180
delta_bow_t = 0.05
delta_target_t = 0.02
arrow_speed = 0.9

# Draw Target
target_pos = vector(-6, 0, 0)
target1 = cylinder(pos=target_pos, axis=vec(0.1,0,0), radius=1, color=vector(1, 1, 1))
target2 = cylinder(pos=target_pos, axis=vec(0.1,0,0), radius=0.8, color=vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
target3 = cylinder(pos=target_pos, axis=vec(0.1,0,0), radius=0.6, color=vector(0, 0, 1))
target4 = cylinder(pos=target_pos, axis=vec(0.1,0,0), radius=0.4, color=vector(1, 0, 0))
target5 = cylinder(pos=target_pos, axis=vec(0.1,0,0), radius=0.2, color=vector(1, 1, 0))
target2.pos.x = target1.pos.x + 0.01
target3.pos.x = target2.pos.x + 0.01
target4.pos.x = target3.pos.x + 0.01
target5.pos.x = target4.pos.x + 0.01

arrow_left_boundary = target_pos.x - 2

# game setting
is_shoot = False
is_hit = False
shoot_count = 0
total_point = 0

def reset():
    global is_shoot, is_hit, total_point, shoot_count
    
    bow_arrow.pos = vec(bow.pos.x-bow_len*0.5, bow.pos.y, 0)
    #bow_arrow.color += 0.1    

    if is_hit == False:
        print("not good... reload!!")

    is_shoot = False
    is_hit = False
    
    if shoot_count == 10:
        print("[final result]", "shoot", shoot_count, "total", total_point)
        shoot_count = 0
        total_point = 0
        prompt("retry?")
        print("[Start New Game]")
    
def hit(point):
    global is_hit, total_point, shoot_count
    is_hit = True
    
    total_point += point
    
    print("hit!", "shoot", shoot_count, "point", point, "total", total_point)
    

def MoveBow(t):
    global acc_bow_t, is_shoot, is_hit
    
    if is_hit == True:
        return
        
    if is_shoot == False :
        acc_bow_t += t;
        bow.pos.y = bow_pos.y + move_height * cos(acc_bow_t)
        bow_arrow.pos.y = bow.pos.y
    else :
        bow_arrow.pos.x -= arrow_speed
        
        # checking hit
        check_x = bow_arrow.pos.x-bow_len*0.5
        
        if abs(check_x - target_pos.x) < bow_len+arrow_speed and abs(bow_arrow.pos.y - target5.pos.y) < target5.radius:
            hit(10)
        elif abs(check_x - target_pos.x) < bow_len+arrow_speed and abs(bow_arrow.pos.y - target4.pos.y) < target4.radius:
            hit(8)
        elif abs(check_x - target_pos.x) < bow_len+arrow_speed and abs(bow_arrow.pos.y - target3.pos.y) < target3.radius:
            hit(6)
        elif abs(check_x - target_pos.x) < bow_len+arrow_speed and abs(bow_arrow.pos.y - target2.pos.y) < target2.radius:
            hit(4)
        elif abs(check_x - target_pos.x) < bow_len+arrow_speed and abs(bow_arrow.pos.y - target1.pos.y) < target1.radius:
            hit(2)
            
        # boundary x
        if bow_arrow.pos.x < arrow_left_boundary:
            reset()

# moving target
def MoveTarget(t):
    global acc_target_t
    
    if is_hit == True:
        return
    
    acc_target_t += t;
    
    target1.pos.y = target_pos.y + move_target_height * sin(acc_target_t) 
    target2.pos.y = target1.pos.y
    target3.pos.y = target2.pos.y
    target4.pos.y = target3.pos.y
    target5.pos.y = target4.pos.y    

# if space key => fire(spawn) arrow
def shoot():
    global is_shoot, shoot_count
    if is_shoot: return

    is_shoot = True
    
    shoot_count += 1
    
    print("shoot", shoot_count)

scene.bind('keydown', shoot)
limit = 50 * 10
# infinite loop

l = label(text = limit)

while limit > 0:
    #scene.camera.pos = bow_arrow.pos + vec(10,10,0)
    
    
    limit -= 1
    l.text = limit
    rate(50)
    
    # move target & bow    
    MoveBow(delta_bow_t)
    MoveTarget(delta_target_t)
    
    # if hit
    if is_hit == True:
        rate(1)
        reset()
l.visible= False
label(text = f"final point : {total_point}, game over")
